usedFor: Asana carries tasks and Qualisend checks email addresses. A “New Task Created in Selected Project” in Asana can start “Verify Email” in Qualisend, so an address put into a task gets a deliverable or risky verdict.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Selected Project” in Asana, then “Verify Email” in Qualisend
bestTemplate.why: If a task is created for each new contact, the address is checked as it comes in. “Verify Email” returns a deliverable, risky, undeliverable or unknown verdict with a score.

watchOut: “Verify Email List” starts a bulk job and needs a list or CSV, so a single task gives it little. Both Asana triggers are polling, so checks wait for the next poll.
